goals.title: Step 1 (S1): Return seat toolEvidence to manager and verifier
goals.description: Return compact toolEvidence from all 4 return sites in seatToolLoop.ts, attach on report in analystExecution.ts, include Tool evidence block in synthesisPipeline.ts buildBettingPrompt inside cap, pass joined toolResults on rawData in verificationPipeline.ts, and remove SANITIZE: Discard raw values from ANALYST_SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION.
goals.verificationCriteria: Manager prompt and verifier toolResults contain seat tool summaries, and betting seats are not told to discard raw values.

goals.title: Step 2 (S5): Mark failed verification verified:false and clear picks
goals.description: In verificationPipeline.ts, when lifecycleResult.success is false, set verified:false, verification:{success:false, attempts, rating}, clear picks and components, and mark summary unverified. On success, set verified:true and verification.success:true.
goals.verificationCriteria: Failed verification returns verified:false, empty picks/components, and unverified summary.

goals.title: Step 3 (S3): Critic emits a verdict only
goals.description: Give critic a verdict instruction and finalInstruction ({pass, verdict, flags}, never propose picks). In guardAnalystResponse, when role is critic/Risk Critic, do not wrap bare arrays into picks, strip any picks, and treat missing pass as contract violation.
goals.verificationCriteria: Critic parlay array has no picks and is not a betting report; {pass, verdict, flags} is accepted.

goals.title: Step 4 (S2): Stop offering get_historical_lessons/get_game_context and prefetch a1/a2 per game
goals.description: Stop appending get_historical_lessons to betting-seat candidateNames in seatToolLoop.ts, remove get_game_context wording from constants.ts, and prefetch per-game role tools for Quant/Market (a1/a2) with buildPrefetchCalls bounded by existing caps.
goals.verificationCriteria: a1/a2 are not offered get_historical_lessons or get_game_context; prefetch covers each slate game until cap.

goals.title: Step 5 (S4): Authoritative slate team names instruction
goals.description: Add 'Team names in Game Slate are authoritative; never rename or flag them.' to analyst and verifier instructions.
goals.verificationCriteria: Line present in betting-seat and verifier instructions.

goals.title: Step 6: Repro tests, full verification, push branch, and open PR
goals.description: Create/run src/__repro__/chatRunNov16.repro.test.ts, run touched and full vitest, tsc --noEmit, smoke-start, push fix/seat-evidence-verdicts, and open PR.
goals.verificationCriteria: All new/touched tests pass; tsc & smoke pass; PR opened on GitHub.
